name: convention-over-configuration

# Convention Over Configuration

## Purpose

Apply this skill whenever designing, configuring, or implementing software.

Follow existing conventions before introducing custom configuration.

---

## Before Starting

Verify the following:

- [ ] Existing project conventions have been reviewed.
- [ ] Existing naming conventions are understood.
- [ ] Existing folder structures are understood.

---

## Before Finishing

Verify the following:

- [ ] Existing project conventions were followed.
- [ ] Naming is consistent.
- [ ] Folder structure remains consistent.
- [ ] Existing configuration mechanisms were reused.
- [ ] New configuration was introduced only when necessary.

---

## Common Mistakes

Avoid:

- Creating custom patterns.
- Unnecessary configuration files.
- Inconsistent naming.
- Multiple approaches to solving the same problem.

---

## Definition of Done

- [ ] The implementation aligns with existing conventions.
- [ ] Configuration has been minimized.
- [ ] The project remains consistent.
